module: "Get Vehicle Data" node (category `repeat_instant`). Provides position, directions, rotation, speed, activity and damage from `map.objects[vehId]`. Outputs: `position`, `dirVec`, `dirVecUp`, `rotation`, `velocity` (m/s), `velocityVector`, `active`, `damage`, `newAPIDamage` (`getSectionDamageSum`). Unconnected outputs are not computed (`isUsed`). Input pin: `vehId` (default 0, otherwise player).
notes: If `vehId` refers to a nonexistent object, `vehId` stays at -1 and nothing is written.
The `if not vehId` test is useless because `vehId` is always defined.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

work.desc: Reads `map.objects[vehId]` and fills the connected outputs.
